description: Fetch the Emails tab configuration for your GrowSurf program (participant and admin email templates and settings). Returns the full object with every field and its current value — the same shape you send back on update. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_get_campaign_emails

outputSchema.description: A program's email configuration. Each template property is an object with `subject`, `preheader`, `body` (HTML), and `isEnabled` (plus `useCompanyReplyTo` on the invite email). The templates available depend on the program type. `GET` returns the full object; `PATCH` back only the fields you want to change.

affiliateApplicationApproved.description: Tells an applicant their affiliate application was approved. Affiliate programs only. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

affiliateApplicationDenied.description: Tells an applicant their affiliate application was not approved. Affiliate programs only. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

affiliateApplicationEmailCorrection.description: Asks an applicant to confirm a corrected email address. Its body must contain `{{identityVerificationLink}}`. Affiliate programs only. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

affiliateApplicationReceived.description: Confirms an affiliate application was received and is under review. Affiliate programs only. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

affiliateApplicationStatusLink.description: Sends an applicant a secure link to view their application status. Its body must keep `{{applicationStatusLink}}`. Affiliate programs only. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

affiliateEmailChangeVerification.description: Asks an affiliate to confirm a new account email address. Its body must contain `{{identityVerificationLink}}`. Affiliate programs only. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

campaignEndedNonWinners.description: Sent to non-winners when the program ends. Referral programs only.

campaignEndedWinners.description: Sent to reward winners when the program ends. Referral programs only.

commissionAdjusted.description: Sent when a commission is adjusted after a refund or chargeback. Affiliate programs only.

commissionGenerated.description: Sent to an affiliate when they earn a new commission. Affiliate programs only.

goalAchieved.description: Sent when a participant unlocks a reward. Referral programs only.

invite.description: The invitation email a participant sends to friends. `useCompanyReplyTo` sets who receives replies.

inviteAffiliate.description: Invites a prospective affiliate to join the program. Its body must keep `{{affiliateInviteLink}}`. Affiliate programs only. Promotional; its toggle can be changed.

loginLink.description: One-time sign-in link for returning participants. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

offerClaimed.description: Sent when a referred visitor saves an offer through the Claim Offer Popup. Referral and affiliate programs. Promotional; its toggle can be changed.

payoutDestinationChanged.description: Tells a participant their payout destination changed. Its body must keep `{{payoutDestinationMaskedEmail}}`. Referral and affiliate programs. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

payoutDestinationConfirmation.description: Asks a participant to confirm the payout destination where they will receive payouts, such as a PayPal or Wise email address. Its body may use `{{payoutProvider}}` and must keep `{{payoutDestinationConfirmationLink}}`. Referral and affiliate programs. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

payoutPending.description: Sent when a payout is on the way. Affiliate programs only.

payoutSentSuccess.description: Sent when a payout completes. Affiliate programs only.

progressUpdateMonthly.description: Month-end progress recap for participants. Referral and affiliate programs.

referralLinkUsed.description: Sent to a referrer when they earn referral credit. Referral programs only.

referralLinkViewedFirstTime.description: Sent the first time a participant's referral link is viewed. Referral and affiliate programs.

referredSignup.description: Sent to a referrer each time someone signs up using their link. Referral and affiliate programs.

settings.description: Sender (`sender`), physical contact address (`contact`), and shared design (`design`) settings. The design object includes `unsubscribeAffiliateInvite` for direct affiliate invitation emails.

taxInfoApproved.description: Tells a participant their tax form is complete and approved. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

taxInfoMissing.description: Asks a participant to submit required tax information. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

taxInfoReceived.description: Confirms submitted tax information was received. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

taxInfoRejected.description: Tells a participant their tax information needs to be resubmitted. Transactional; its toggle cannot be changed.

welcomeNonReferred.description: Welcome email for a participant who joins without being referred. Referral and affiliate programs.

welcomeReferred.description: Welcome email for someone who signs up through a referral link. Referral programs only.

title: Get Program Emails
